topics.title: Autonomous Flight Corridor & Waypoint Mission Planning
topics.objective: Compute serpentine waypoint flight grids with 75% forward overlap and 65% sidelap for orthomosaic reconstruction.
topics.exercise: Calculate ground sampling distance (GSD) and flight mission duration for a 150-hectare industrial surveying grid.

topics.title: Airspace Geofencing & Digital Sky (NPNT) Compliance
topics.objective: Verify green/yellow/red airspace authorizations and execute No Permission, No Takeoff (NPNT) digital signing tokens.
topics.example: if (airspace_zone == 'RED' or not npnt_token_valid) { disarm_motors(); trigger_buzzer(); }
topics.exercise: Draft an automated pre-flight clearance validator checking real-time NOTAMs and airspace boundaries.

topics.title: RTK / PPK Differential GNSS & Ground Control Points (GCPs)
topics.objective: Calibrate centimeter-accurate geotagging using real-time kinematic (RTK) base stations and surveyed ground targets.
topics.exercise: Design a 10-point GCP distribution layout across varied topography ensuring horizontal accuracy within 3cm.

topics.title: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) & 3D Dense Mesh Reconstruction
topics.objective: Process high-resolution aerial imagery into dense point clouds, digital surface models (DSM), and textured 3D meshes.
topics.exercise: Execute a point cloud generation pipeline calculating earthwork cut-and-fill volume estimates from DSM differentials.

topics.title: Emergency Failsafe, Geocaging & Return-to-Home (RTH)
topics.objective: Configure low-battery thresholds, link-loss failover behaviors, and automated obstacle avoidance return trajectories.
topics.exercise: Formulate a critical emergency response procedure handling dual-motor degradation and GNSS jamming incidents.
